exchanges: Good morning, back from the garden and honestly the zucchini have gone wild this year, I picked eleven of them and nobody wants them anymore so I have been leaving them on porches when nobody is looking
That is a generous kind of mischief. Have you tried zucchini bread with some of them?
ha yes made three loaves already, the freezer is full, anyway I sat down with my tea finally
You have earned it after a morning like that.
I have been doing my Italian lessons on the phone app while I rest, twenty minutes a day, my teacher brain cant stop wanting homework apparently
Old habits from the classroom. How far along are you?
only on the unit about ordering food so I can order a coffee and thats about it, my sister Ifeoma laughs at me
Ordering coffee is a very useful first skill.
she would know about practical, she has been a manager at Costco for nearly twenty years and she is the most organised person I know
Twenty years in one place is impressive.
and my brother's wife Chiamaka just started at Staples in the print department so half the family is in retail now except me the old teacher
That must make for good stories at family dinners.
it does, we had a big lunch on sunday and I watched the Raptors game after with my grandson, I have loved that team since the year they started
Watching with family makes the games more fun.
they lost though so it was not so fun haha
There is always the next game.
the other volunteers want to throw a surprise party for Rafael our treasurer and they asked me to help plan it
That is a nice thing to do. What is the occasion?
he turns seventy in October so we are aiming for a weekend around then if the weather holds
Seventy deserves a proper celebration.
my back has been bad again though, the doctor finally gave it a name, sciatica, and said no more lifting the big watering cans
That sounds painful. Are you able to rest it?
I try but you know me, I cannot sit still
Maybe there are lighter jobs at the garden you can take on for a while.
true I could do the seed labels, my grandson Bertrand would tell me to rest, he is very serious now that he is at Dalhousie
It is sweet that he worries about you.
he phones every sunday, which is more than his father ever did
That is a lovely habit for him to have.
oh and I have to correct myself, I told you Italian earlier but no, it is Portuguese I am learning, Italian was what I tried two years ago and gave up on, my head is all over the place today
No problem, thanks for setting it straight.
my friend Mei Ling is getting married again in September, a small ceremony, she asked me to read a poem
What an honour. Do you have a poem in mind?
not yet I am thinking something by Mary Oliver
Her poems about nature would suit a gardener reading at a wedding.
yes exactly, oh my phone is buzzing, this Samsung my son gave me makes the loudest noises and I cannot figure out how to turn it down
There is usually a volume setting under sounds in the settings menu.
I will ask Bertrand when he calls
He will probably sort it out in a minute.
the light is so nice this time of day in the kitchen
Afternoon light in a kitchen is one of the nicest things.
I might do a bit of reading before dinner
Sounds like a relaxing plan.
svetlana from the garden is coming by to pick up zucchini, finally someone wants them
Good, one less batch to give away.
she is bringing her little dog too, she takes him everywhere
Dogs at the garden are always good company.
sorry where was it ifeoma works again, my sister
ah the doorbell, its her, the dachshund is already barking at me through the window
Sounds like you have visitors. Enjoy the zucchini handover.
she says hello by the way
Hello to her too.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your sister Ifeoma works at Costco.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your sister Ifeoma works at Staples.

what month is mei ling's wedding
so the language I'm working on is Portuguese, right?
what kind of dog does svetlana have
I think I'll make a salad with the last of the lettuce tonight
where does rafael work, outside of the garden I mean
which school did mei ling go to
sorry, the store my sister works at, which one was it
